brief:
A federal judge in New York granted a preliminary injunction on October 13, 2026, blocking the Trump administration from enforcing sanctions against the International Criminal Court, according to DAWN and Taxpayers Alliance Against Genocide. The two organizations, which advocate for Palestinian rights, said the ruling represented a victory for free speech and justice.

The injunction prevents the government from carrying out the sanctions while legal challenges to the enforcement action proceed.
dek: (NEW YORK, N.Y., October 13, 2026) – In a landmark victory for free speech and justice, the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York today granted a preliminary injunction blocking the Trump administration from enforcing its sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) against DAWN and Taxpayers Alliance Against Genocide (TAAG), the two organizations said today.
title: U.S. court blocks Trump sanctions on ICC advocacy groups
